title: Barrett: emotion categories are constructed, not a direct readout

body: Barrett's theory of constructed emotion, in the account whose DOI record lists an online date of 2016-10-12, says the science of emotion has been using folk-psychological categories to look for a brain basis. The paper's move is to start from the brain: it runs an internal model on past experience, implemented as concepts, and a perception or experience is a prediction that has explained the sensory input and directed action. Categorizing is that process. Emotions, on this account, are constructed categories, not pre-packaged natural kinds waiting in the signal. The DOI page was read. A coordinate system is not stated there, and none is copied here. Constructed emotion and Ekman's basic emotions do not say the same thing about what a feeling is. Both remain in the literature.

sources.title: The theory of constructed emotion: an active inference account of interoception and categorization
